author: Abby Kyriakoutsakos Marrazzo
text:
Bella Russo I think what people mean is that your symptoms may not match because of several things: 
1) compression lows are not real and you need to know the difference. 
2) the number with almost never be the same as a FSBG because your monitor isn’t reading glucose from blood. It is also going to be behind and if you haven’t moved for a while, it can drop extremely low because the interstitial fluid isn’t moving and has lost glucose in that area. 

If you’re new to this, there’s a learning curve. As a cancer survivor who has to use a CGM as a result, I do understand the level of concern — but you always double check with a FSBG when in doubt and the CGM is not meant to replace that, especially in brittle cases.
